cfg.seed_rule: S0/S3 paired: BASE3+100+50*cid+1000*kind+10*rung+seed_idx (kind 0 = h2h, 1 = extend rungs); S2: BASE3+300+50*cid+rung
cfg.level_m_extrapolation: linear interp between pilot-observed levels; beyond the last: m_last + (h - h_last), capped at h (one in-frame point per step at most)
cfg.cost_convention: iter_evals = vectorized step() applications (phase-1 chunk work + resolve/plot per-step work)
cfg.reference: study data/ref_{map}_{cap}.npz (S0 @ 40M, 2026-10-21) + analyze.roi_from_ref top-decile ROI, reused read-only
